source_refs.note: Speciation: a main subheading of 1.8 Species and speciation, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 32-32.

blocks.text: Speciation woh evolutionary process hai jis se ek saanjhe buzurg (common ancestor) se nayi species banti hain. Is mein genetic tabdeeliyan jama hoti jati hain, jo aakhir aabadiyon (populations) ke darmiyan reproductive isolation paida kar deti hain. Speciation ke kai tareeqe (mechanisms) hain, maslan:
